title: Character Video Master
description: Microdramas, UGC and influencer clips: Qwen-Edit builds the first frame (the main character in the background, in the outfit) and MiniMax H3 animates it. Or reference mode builds a new scene from your references. Optional SeedVR2 upscale.

labels.2:value: Describe the action, camera, dialogue and sound. Call the first frame <Picture 1>.
labels.26:value: Keyframe prompt (how Qwen-Edit puts the character into the background)

choices.label: Build the first frame
choices.hint: Qwen-Edit puts CHARACTER 1 into the BACKGROUND in the OUTFIT, then H3 animates that frame: the steadiest face, room and light.

choices.label: My first frame
choices.hint: H3 animates the FIRST FRAME you add (and ends on LAST FRAME if you add one).

choices.label: Reference mode
choices.hint: H3 invents the shot from the character, outfit, background, prop, motion video and voice sample. Slower, and the set can drift.

choices.label: Final
choices.hint: the full model, the final steps below

choices.label: On
choices.hint: SeedVR2 7B sharp, to the short edge below

hints: Build the first frame (the default) kept the face, room and light locked for the whole clip in testing.
Best results come from 5-6 s clips, one action each. Keep the seed fixed while you change the prompt.
For speech, put the words in quotes after "Audio:". A VOICE TRACK makes the lips follow your own audio.
